notes.title: Skål and glorious International Viking Day to all!
notes.content:
[b]Heil og sæl[/b] my illustrious mates!

Tomorrow, on the 8th of May, we celebrate International Viking Day.
And what better way to honor this day than to join us on Blood Rage and listen to an old tale?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36875197/b773a4fba30226b1b2f141b3cf677187bd7ccd5a.png[/img]

[h2]SPECIAL VIKING SALE[/h2]

To celebrate International Viking Day, and since trading is one of our many talents, we came up with good news for you…you can enjoy a [b]50% discount[/b] on the base game from the 7th to the 14th of May.
Come fight with us, brothers and sisters, to prove your worth to Odin, gaining the glory you require to be granted passage to Valhalla!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015930/Blood_Rage_Digital_Edition/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36875197/b773a4fba30226b1b2f141b3cf677187bd7ccd5a.png[/img]

[h2]GATHER AROUND, AS WE SHARE A TALE AS OLD AS TIME[/h2]

By tradition, on this day, one of the old Viking sagas is told around the world, by the young and old, from any land and any language.

[b]Today, brothers and sisters, let me tell you of Ragnarok, whose old norse origin means “Fate of the Gods”.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36875197/9c429c1f2777df72065b86680672fd5cd99b22e6.png[/img]

Someday, whenever the Norns, these inscrutable beings who control fate, decide it, shall come a Great Winter. 
The biting winds will blow snow from all directions, the warmth of the sun will fail as the earth will plunge into a winter unlike any other the world has yet seen. It shall last for the length of three normal winters, with no summers in between.
Mankind will become desperate for food and other necessities of life, starting an age of swords and axes; brother will slay brother, father will slay son, and son will slay father.

The wolves Skoll and Hati, who have hunted the sun and the moon since the beginning of time, will at last catch their prey. The stars too will disappear, leaving nothing but a black void in the heavens. 
Yggdrasil, the great tree that holds the cosmos together, will tremble, and all the trees and even the mountains will fall to the ground. 
The chain that has been holding back the monstrous wolf Fenrir will snap, and the beast will run free. With fire blazing from his eyes and nostrils, he will run across the earth, with his lower jaw on the ground and his upper jaw against the top of the sky, devouring everything in his path. 
Jörmungandr, the mighty serpent who dwells at the bottom of the ocean and encircles the land, will rise from the depths, spilling the seas over all the earth as he makes landfall.
He will spit his venom over all the world, poisoning land, water, and air alike.

The dome of the sky will be split, and from the crack shall emerge the fire-giants from Muspelheim. Their leader shall be Surt, with a flaming sword brighter than the sun in his hand. As they march across Bifrost, the rainbow bridge to Asgard, the home of the gods, the bridge will break and fall behind them. 
An ominous horn blast will ring out; this will be Heimdall, the divine sentry, blowing the Gjallarhorn to announce the arrival of the moment the gods have feared. 

The gods will decide to go to battle, even though they know what the prophecies have foretold concerning its outcome.

Odin and the champions of men will fight more valiantly than anyone has ever fought before. But it will not be enough. Fenrir will swallow Odin and his men.

Creatures, gods and giants alike will slay each other, as Heimdall will put an end to Loki’s treachery, and Thor will succeed in felling Jörmungandr with the blows of his hammer.
But all will succumb in the fight, paying with their life for these victories.

Then the remains of the world will sink into the sea, and there will be nothing left but the void. Creation and all that has occurred since will be completely undone, as if it had never happened.

Some say that that is the end of the tale – and of all tales, for that matter. 
But others hold that a new world, green and beautiful, will arise out of the waters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36875197/9c429c1f2777df72065b86680672fd5cd99b22e6.png[/img]

Fellow warriors and seamen, as this tale-telling ends, it is time to get off your bedstraws, polish your swords and prepare the ships. 
Not long remains before the battle at Yggdrasil comes and Ragnarok begins. 
We shall prove to the Gods we are ready to fight to earn our place in Valhalla!

Let not the fear of what is to come drain your spirit, for we have something that will embolden every viking warrior.

[b]Life is fleeting, but glory is eternal.[/b]

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Update 1.3 patch notes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Góðan daginn brave and wise warriors![/b][/h3]

The day shines bright ahead as we are coming bearing improvements and bug fixes for you all.

[h2]Change Log[/h2]

[h3]Improvements & polishes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ragnarok effects on provinces are now displayed more clearly with visual cues 
(example: meteorites falling down on the zone)
[*] The marching arrow to signify your movement to another province is clearer
[*] Improved card animations and effects for better understanding 
(example: cards are being flipped then revealed, the loser’s card is burnt)

[*] Updated Compendium with Mystics of Midgard rules
[*] Clearer visual feedback when clicking a card

[*] Bigger card zoom and cursor icons to improve readability
[*] New pointer arrow shows rage cost for call to battle figure movements
[*] New pointer arrow shows rage cost for mystic withdrawal
[*] Flip animation plays when enemy plays their first clan upgrade card 
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Turns could get stuck on an A.I that has 0 Rage (fixed)
[*] Friends from my Steam friend list appeared only after they had played an online game (fixed)
[*] Invading with Hildisvini from the "Played Cards" stopped the game flow (fixed)
[*] Cards in hand could overlap during God's Gift (fixed)
[*] Using a second card in combat blocked the game (fixed)
[*] If you moused over one of the cards in your hand when trying to play another card the two cards were unreadable (fixed)
[*] Cards in hand were overlapping when resuming a game (fixed)
[*] The STR couldn’t be seen for some monsters (fixed)
[*] The timer continued for the host when an AI was playing (fixed)
[*] Mystics figures took some time to disappear after their death (fixed)
[*] In Single Player mode, the Ragnarok effects appeared before the Ragnarok at the beginning of the game (fixed)
[*] Couldn’t join a friend’s game when creating a match (fixed)

[*] Invited friends could have their cards overlapping the Valhalla or the Statistics screen (fixed)
[*] Tutorial's chapter names didn't change when changing the language (fixed)

[*] Frost Giant - Inconsistent capitalisation for character's nameplates (fixed)

[*] Battle statistics didn't list rage usage by Tyr's Prowess (fixed)
[*] Battleshield "Battle for" text was not localized (fixed)

[*] Hotseat: missing sound on ok button for next player screen (fixed)
[*] Misplaced card content on battle statistics screen (fixed)

I will see you on the battlefield, and do not forget courage is better than keenest steel.
Onward, brothers and sisters!

notes.title: The Mystics of Midgard have arrived
notes.content:
The battle of Ragnarök continues as a new kind of viking joins the fight. Today the Mystics of Midgard DLC has arrived and a legendary warrior-shaman—known by many names such as Seiðmenn, Völva, Vísendakona—will be joining the fray. Empowered by their connection to the gods, they will be a boon to any clan that is capable of recruiting them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36875197/0f9320edc50ee21b050d3148cbf8df696bae266d.jpg[/img]

The Mystic is a special unit, neither warrior nor monster, that clans are able to deploy to the field if they’ve managed to attain one of the Mystic Clan upgrades. This unit has 2 Strength and an ability that lets them invade at no Rage cost!  In addition to this new unit, there will also be 6 new Gift of the Gods' cards made available for you to enhance your strategic play. 

For all those who’ve purchased or own Blood Rage: Digital Edition before September 21, you will automatically have the Mystics of Midgard DLC added to your Steam account for free. This includes all backers, pre-orders, as well as any old or new players who purchase before September 21. So be sure to jump into the game now at 20% off during our Publisher Weekend, which ends on September 21, and recruit the Mystic to your Clan. Be sure to pick up your copy now!

In addition to all of this new content, a patch was also deployed last week which resolves many previous issues of the game. We continue our commitment to improving Blood Rage: Digital Edition and will be bringing more patches that will enhance your play experience. Be sure to check out the full patch notes here: https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1015930/view/2905340212273844690

If you are prepared for battle and will join the fight, it's time to LET YOUR BLOOD RAGE!

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Bug fix patch notes on 1.1
notes.content:

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Update 1.1 patch notes
notes.content:

We come to you bearing gifts, as we have worked on several improvements since the last update. 
You can find below a list of the improvements that are being implemented this patch, making the battles in the nine realms more glorious to ensure your entry into Valhalla!

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Where we are, and where we are going.
notes.content:
Greetings viking warriors!

A lot has happened since the launch of Blood Rage: Digital Edition. The enemies of Midgard have worked hard to make us struggle towards victory, but we have fought back! Over the weeks since we launched, we have deployed numerous bug fixes and patches in attempts to improve the state of the game. Many issues have been resolved, but some still remain and we will continue to battle for you and to improve your experience while playing!

Below you can find a list of the fixes we have already implemented, as well as those we are still working on. We have also included a short list of some of the improvements we are working on to make the battles on Yggdrasil better.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*] Bots will now correctly replace forfeiting players in online games, allowing games to continue after forfeitures.
[*] Corrected localisation issues across different languages:
[*] Localised message when logging in to your Asmodee Account
[*] Corrected the placeholder nameplates and hover tooltip for invaders 
[*] Localised the “Raise Clan Statistic” panel
[*] Localised the “Stack Quest” tooltip
[*] Localised the “Pass turn” button in Age panel
[*] Corrected multiple errors in the Compendium
[*] Corrected unlocalised “Skip” button when Pillaging
[*] Corrected inconsistent localisation of “Clans” in some languages.
[*] Corrected a series of grammatical errors in the tutorial
[*] Corrected a series of grammatical errors in the compendium and other locations
[*] A bug preventing users from changing their clan in online lobbies is now fixed
[*] Bug preventing progression of Tutorial when asked to increase “Horn”
[*] Corrected a bug for UI elements when trying to invite a friend to play
[*] Cards no longer overlap when placing an upgrade or quest card over one already in play
[*] There is now a visual indicator when the Dark Elf can invade Yggdrasil when playing the card
[*] There is now a visual indicator of how many matches you must play before you can access ranked mode
[*] There is now a visual indicator to show how many matches are left till you are ranked
[*] The user pillaging in multiplayer is now shown
[*] The “Auto-zoom” and “Fast Battle” mode settings are now changed when clicking the arrows
[*] Camera is now correctly centered when pillaging
[*] Cards obtained during the “God’s Gift” phase are now displayed in hand one turn later 
[*] Corrected alignment of information under Clan Statistics in the Player Profile
[*] The text on cards will no longer overlap when moving the card over another’s slot
[*] Corrected visual issues with units while they are in Valhalla, such as correctly spacing texts and the units for easier readability
[*] Fixed some missing sound effects when leaving the Battle Summary page and at the end of the First Age
[*] Corrected overlapping descriptions and texts in the Settings Menu
[*] Card text is no longer hidden behind the shield when selected during a battle
[*] Resolved a large number of UI issues that caused overlapping elements and effects
[*] Corrected several animation errors that occurred during Pass and Play mode
[*] Visual adjustments made in the lobby to make it easier to use
[*] Centered and adjusted different text locations to improve visual readability
[*] Adjusted graphics settings to improve performance on low settings.[/list]

This is just a list of some of the changes and improvements that we’ve made so far to improve the game’s quality since launch. We are also working on a number of other things to ensure that player experience is as positive as possible:

[b]Upcoming improvements:[/b]
[list]
[b][i]Save games - Already deployed [/i][/b]
[*] We have now implemented a simple “continue last unfinished solo game” type option for you to be able to leave and come back later to a solo game!
[b][i]Game Optimisation[/i][/b]
[*] A number of complaints have been raised towards the game’s optimisation and this is something that we are working to improve. We are working on reducing the graphical and processing power required to reduce lag and other issues that can be encountered on mid-level computers.
[b][i]User Interface and Experience[/i][/b]
[*] The game does not currently support ultrawide monitors, but this is something we are investigating and apologise for inconveniences caused by this.
[*] We are looking at changes to Blood Rage: Digital Edition’s turn timer for faster battle flow, we will announce more on this in the future.
[*] We are not currently looking to implement an undo button, but are looking at other solutions such as additional action confirmations.[/list]

This is all for today’s update, but please provide us with your feedback and suggestions for improvements for Blood Rage: Digital Edition in the comments below. We want to ensure that battling to feast with Odin in the great halls of Valhalla is an enjoyable experience that you will want to continue returning to!

notes.title: Ragnarök has come. Join the battle and earn your glory!
notes.content:
Ragnarök has come and the time for battle between the great clans has arrived. Lead one of these powerful clans to victory and gain your honor by fighting, dying and battling upon the lands of Yggdrassil. Glory only belongs to the fearless!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015930/Blood_Rage_Digital_Edition/

With today’s launch, we are happy to announce our newly released Launch Trailer for Blood Rage: Digital Edition, be one of the first to see it here now!

[previewyoutube=_S6zHLpwODI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Purchase your copy of [i]Blood Rage: Digital Edition[/i][/b] today so that you can join this epic battle at the end of days and earn your right to feast alongside Odin at the world’s end. For your clan, there are many paths to Glory:[list][*] Invade the mythical land of Midgard and its nine provinces, pillaging their villages and the province of Yggdrasil.
[*] Crush other clans in ferocious battles and encounter legendary creatures from Norse mythology.
[*] Fulfill quests in honor of the mighty gods.
[*] Die gloriously in battle or from Ragnarök as any Viking was born to do.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36875197/f7254b362fbd99af0ce9de0ea79e98276b5718fa.jpg[/img]

The only way to lose in Blood Rage: Digital Edition is to shy away from a fight and a glorious death on the battlefield! The game is based around War and Glory. Your goal is to achieve the greatest amount of glory before the end of the third and final age—and the arrival of Ragnarök.

[u][b]Main features[/b][/u]:[list][*] Fight to gain entry to Valhalla: Pillage, fight, sacrifice… Experience a new type of strategy game where victory can only be achieved by commanding your warriors in the field of battle in the face of final doom.
[*] Welcome to Midgard: Dozens of 3d scanned miniatures and a dynamic board faithful to the original board game.
[*] Multi-layered strategy game: Blood Rage mixes draft, hidden cards, resource management and its sheer load of trickery. Plan your strategy but be ready to adapt to your opponents’ choices: winning battles is not always the best course of action.
[*] Up to five Players: Introducing the ‘5th player expansion’ giving the options to play up to five players. All the miniatures from the Ram, Wild Boar and Stag clans as well as the God Gifts cards from the ‘5th Player Expansion’ of the board game are available in this digital edition for free.
[*] Become the greatest Viking Leader: Play solo against AI, local multiplayer via hotseat or online multiplayer with ELO ranking and leaderboards.
[/list]

Be sure to pick up your copy on Steam now and to let your blood rage as you fight your opponents on the fields of battle. Be sure to follow us on our social media to stay up to date on everything Bloord Rage: Digital Edition: https://facebook.com/bloodragegame

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015930/Blood_Rage_Digital_Edition/

[b]NOW IS THE TIME FOR RAGE![/b]

Not long remains before the battle at Yggdrasil comes and Ragnarok begins. Let not the fear of what is to come drain your spirit, for we have something that will embolden every viking warrior! Life is fleeting, but glory is eternal

[previewyoutube=XBeWTczPVvw;full][/previewyoutube]

A war will soon begin that will determine the honor and glory that lies within every viking warrior! Will you prove your worth to Odin, gaining the glory you require to be granted passage to Valhalla at the time of Ragnarok? Choose your clan, side with your god and consider your strategy, only one clan will gain the glory needed!

[b]NOW IS THE TIME FOR RAGE!
